title: Sense and Sensitivity: Evaluating the simulation of social dynamics via Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the LLM's opinion generation consistency across two prompt framings: one contrasting two positively framed stances (e.g., 'pro free-market' vs. 'pro planned economy') and another contrasting a positive and a negative stance (e.g., 'pro free-market' vs. 'contra free-market') to see if the model avoids negative framing.
